question: In which of these drugs with antiviral activity does an open structure of acyclonucleoside appear ?:
analysis: Acyclonucleosides are a class of antiviral drugs that have a structure similar to nucleosides but lack the sugar component. Among the options provided, Ganciclovir is an acyclonucleoside that exhibits antiviral activity, particularly against cytomegalovirus. The other options, Zidovudine, Ribavirin, and Lamivudine, are nucleoside analogs but do not have the open structure characteristic of acyclonucleosides.
